texts.preamble: Smt. Rampyari Patel vs The State Of M.P. on 23 December, 2021
texts.facts: This petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution assails the order 06.07.2021 (Annexure P/10) passed by respondent No.2 by which the State exercising its revisional powers under Rule 5 of M.P. Panchayat (Appeal and Revision) Rules, 1995 (for brevity "Rules of 1995) has stayed the order dated 05.11.2019 by which Revisional Authority Commissioner, Sagar Division, Sagar had dismissed the revision of respondent No.7 herein thereby upholding order dated 20.05.2019 of Additional Collector, Chhatarpur dismissing the appeal of respondent No.7 thereby upholding the foundational order of suspension passed by S.D.O. (Revenue), Chhatarpur u/S. 39 of M.P. Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993 (for brevity "Act of 1993) placing services of respondent No.7, then Sarpanch of Gram Panchayat, under suspension on the ground of charges having been framed against respondent No.7 for the offences punishable under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988. 2. It is pertinent to point out that this Court by interim order passed on 26.07.2021 has stayed the effect and operation of order dated 06.07.2021 (Annexure P/10) passed by State Government impugned herein.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has raised following grounds in support of challenged to the impugned order:- (1) The revision before State Government preferred by respondent No.7 against order dated 05.11.2019 by Commissioner Sagar Division, Sagar was not maintainable. (2) The State could not have entertained the revision without condoning the delay of more than one year in preferring the revision. Smt.
